subject: Final MAP affirmation and execution / signature plan for Lumica Health
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
To: Ella Turner <ella.turner@lumicahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + MAP v2 attached

Ella — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and an updated Mutual Action Plan (attached: Lumica_MAP_v2.xlsx) reflecting the items we discussed. High level:

- Target go-live: July 22, 2026 (customer preference noted).
- Proposed target close/signature window: by June 15 — procurement confirmed will initiate their review this week.
- Key milestones (draft):
  • Security & privacy review — Lumica security team — target complete by Jun 20
  • Commercial & legal review — Lumica procurement & Redwood legal — target complete by Jun 15
  • Tech integration (API keys, VPC peering if required) — Redwood infra & Lumica eng — dev sprint Jun 22–Jul 3
  • Pilot / smoke test — Lumica QA & Redwood solutions — Jul 6–Jul 12

Responsibilities are called out in column B of the attached. Dependencies we flagged on the call: SOC 2 evidence required for procurement, and confirmation of production network access model (VPC vs. hosted).

Next steps I'm proposing:
1) Ella/procurement: mark any MAP changes inline in the attached and return by EOD Friday 6/12.
2) Lumica to confirm final decision authority (name & email) for signature.
3) Redwood (me + Rafael): update SOW draft and prepare DocuSign envelope once MAP is affirmed.

If there are any timeline push constraints we didn't capture, call them out in your reply and we'll adjust the milestones.

Attachments: Lumica_MAP_v2.xlsx (MAP with milestone / RACI), SOW-draft-Lumica.pdf (initial draft).

Thanks — talk soon,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.inference.com
+1 415-555-0189

From: Ella Turner <ella.turner@lumicahealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Lumica Health Procurement <procure@lumicahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP v2 attached

Vanessa — thanks for the notes and the MAP. A few immediate items from procurement/security side: 

- Procurement will need SOC 2 Type II report and an updated data flow diagram (PII handling) attached or accessible by Jun 15.
- Security team requests the "Security & privacy review" milestone be moved earlier to complete by Jun 20; they can convene a call on Jun 17 if needed.
- We would prefer go-live target of July 22 (same as your note) but need a two-week verification window after pilot.
- Decision authority for the contract is our CFO, Carla Medina (carla.medina@lumicahealth.com). She will sign on Lumica's side; procurement will handle routing.

I'm attaching a redline of the MAP (see inline comments in Lumica_MAP_v2_comments). Procurement contact is procurement@lumicahealth.com — they will be in touch about DocuSign routing.

If Redwood can confirm availability for a short security call on Jun 17, please propose two 30-min slots.

Best,
Ella Turner
Director, Digital Ops | Lumica Health
ella.turner@lumicahealth.com

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.inference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP v2 attached — timeline / pilot suggestion

Vanessa / Marissa — quick thoughts from AE/solutions: 

- Agree with moving security review earlier. We should offer a 2-week pilot window starting Jul 6 so Lumica has time for validation; pilot could be limited to 50K tokens/day to control cost and scope.
- I'll attach a short SOW addendum to make pilot explicit and cap the pilot usage (attached SOW-draft-Lumica.pdf). Please confirm if legal wants different language for liability/termination during pilot.
- Operational ask: can we freeze code changes on the Redwood side the week of Jul 12 (post-pilot) to stabilize the production push? Marking that as a dependency in the MAP helps set expectations.

Action items for this thread:
1) Vanessa: incorporate Ella's procurement notes (SOC 2 + decision authority) and Rafael's pilot language into MAP v3 and circulate.
2) Connor: loop Redwood legal if the contract language needs adjustment for pilot liability.
3) Marissa: prepare a short runbook for pilot support (on-call contacts, escalation path).

Thanks — Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.inference.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
To: Ella Turner <ella.turner@lumicahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.inference.com>, Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: MAP v3 attached — consolidated milestones, pilot, and signature plan

Ella — thanks for the fast turnaround. I've consolidated the comments into MAP v3 (attached) and highlighted the changes: security milestone moved to Jun 17–20, pilot window Jul 6–Jul 12, and decision authority set to Carla Medina (CFO).

Summary of the updated MAP v3 (high level):
- Milestones / Owner / Target completion:
  • Security review — Lumica Sec (owner) — complete by 2026-06-20
  • Commercial & legal sign-off — Lumica procurement & Redwood legal — complete by 2026-06-15
  • Tech integration & infra prep — Redwood infra & Lumica eng — 2026-06-22 to 2026-07-03
  • Pilot (50K tokens/day cap) — Lumica QA & Redwood solutions — 2026-07-06 to 2026-07-12
  • Final verification & go/no-go — Lumica exec + Redwood — target 2026-07-20 (final prep)
  • Go-live — 2026-07-22

Signature / execution plan: once Lumica confirms the MAP (affirmation email OK), Redwood will finalize the SOW and send a DocuSign envelope to procurement (procure@lumicahealth.com). Rafael and I will coordinate Redwood legal for any redlines; Connor, if you could flag any legal blockers by EOD 6/12 that would help.

Please reply to this thread with either: (A) Affirmation "MAP accepted, proceed to SOW/DocuSign" OR (B) a short list of final changes. If we receive affirmation, I will initiate DocuSign and aim to have the envelope in procurement's queue same day.

Attachments: Lumica_MAP_v3.xlsx (consolidated with highlights), SOW-draft-Lumica.pdf

Thanks — Vanessa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.inference.com

Subject: Re: MAP v3 attached — consolidated milestones, pilot, and signature plan

Vanessa / team — Affirmation: MAP accepted. Please proceed to SOW finalization and DocuSign routing to procurement (procure@lumicahealth.com).

A few confirmations for the record: 
- Lumica confirms success criteria as defined in MAP v3 (integrations passing smoke tests, latency under agreed SLA for samples specified, QA sign-off after pilot).
- Procurement will start DocuSign routing today and expects signature from CFO Carla Medina by EOD Tue, Jun 15.
- Security team will be available for the Jun 17 call — they prefer 10:00–10:30 AM PT or 3:00–3:30 PM PT.

We look forward to the pilot window beginning Jul 6. Once signed, procurement will share the signed agreement and we can schedule an ops kickoff.

Thanks —
Ella Turner
Director, Digital Ops | Lumica Health
ella.turner@lumicahealth.com
procurement@lumicahealth.com
